_meta.description: Unit holding fee schema for North platform. This is a template only — never write data to this file.

unit_id.description: Unique identifier for the holding — ASX code, APIR code, ISIN, or equivalent. Must be verified against Morningstar or fund registry.

unit_name.description: Full name of the holding exactly as disclosed in the PDS.

management_fees_and_costs.description: Total management fees and costs as disclosed in the holding's PDS.

performance_fee.description: Performance fee as disclosed in the holding's PDS. Null if none applies.

gross_transaction_costs.description: Estimated gross transaction costs as disclosed in the holding's PDS.

buy_spread.description: Buy spread applied when purchasing units, as disclosed in the holding's PDS.

sell_spread.description: Sell spread applied when redeeming units, as disclosed in the holding's PDS.

Rebate.description: Discount of management fees and costs for funds

pds_link.description: Direct URL to the holding's current PDS document.

flags.description: Populated by doc-ingestion agent — do not edit manually.
